Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
For those who loves stats, I'll post here statistics relative to the clans played during our bi-weekly league.

We have 3 evenings on VTES in shops and bars in Paris each week.
Every other week, the game scores are taken into account for the league (the other weeks is dedicated to fun play and playtest).

We keep track of the score of each player for a given clan. I won’t give the results per player, but the results for each clan.

Score: 1 vp = 1 point. In case of a GW, the points are doubled.
Popularity: the number of times points were scored with a clan by a different player.

The results are tallied at the end of each trimester.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
